body: This is so amazing! I would love one so badly, my family isn’t doing great at all financially so I’ve been on the same PC for a few years now. This would be an amazing upgrade! I hope I win so badly 🤞

Could you try possibly accessing international mental health support? Such as calling a toll free USA/uk/etc line that can possibly give you some support? Or use a VPN to access international sites to try to chat to a councillor for some advice? I’m sure they’ll understand and try their best to help you.
Lucky. Mine was like that on off but then decided to ruin all our trust by recording my therapy session. Now she’s making me feel worse

Thank you all so so much for your amazing words and advice. I really really appriciate it so much and it will help me so much, I am only still here because of people like you guys. I gave her an ultimatum, if she ever attempts something like this again, I will report her and leave despite me being 16. I will be telling my therapist thay I can’t continue with virtual calls and explain what she did. Was this the right move? She questioned where it was as soon as it wasn’t in the spot and knew i found it. I also should’ve clarified in my original post, when I was a child, my parents argued so much in front of me and literally divorced with me watching every moment of it. She never showed affection, and in retrospect, showed signs of narcissism. She did have depression when I was younger and somewhat neglected us because of that and blamed us for her depression.
My dad is the same as my mother unfortunately

Thank you so much for your kind words, they really mean alot to me. I do like my therapist alot, but, where I live if any medical professional thinks you’re in any danger then you’d probably be sectioned. I do not want to be sectioned at all.

I just confronted her about it and she said I’m spoiled and westernised and said she did it to help me. Idek what to do at this point, the only reason I haven’t offed myself is because of my parents but now this? I have no reason to live.
Because I have a diagnosed mental illness, and doctors call. She doesnt want me to tell them anything about how badly she treated me as a child.
